product.name: Zombom Men's Cotton Polyester Blend Solid Regular Fit Mandarin Collar Short Kurta
product.description: A men's solid short kurta made from a cotton-polyester blend, featuring a regular fit, full sleeves with cuffs, Mandarin collar and button closure. Designed for casual wear, outings, parties and selected traditional occasions.

pricing_note: The source also shows ₹329 for one variant and ₹439 for another, so pricing is variant-dependent. Do not hard-code ₹439 as the price of every color.

variants.variant_status: Color images supplied for six catalog colors. Source listing contains additional review variants such as Yellow, but no Yellow image was supplied in SHIRT-008, so Yellow is not included in the storefront variant catalog.

review_summary.summary: The product receives substantial positive feedback for comfort, lightweight feel, breathability, fit and value. However, quality consistency is a clear weakness. Verified buyers also report rough or cheap-feeling fabric, loose threads, weak stitching, incorrect sizing and colors differing from the product images.

buying_advice.size_advice: The source lists S through 4XL and explicitly recommends checking the size chart. Reviews show both good-fit and poor-fit experiences, so the size chart should be used rather than relying only on the usual shirt size.
buying_advice.fabric_advice: Describe the material as a cotton-polyester blend. Do not call it pure cotton.
buying_advice.quality_advice: Do not market it as premium or exceptionally durable. The review evidence is too inconsistent.
buying_advice.occasion_advice: This is better positioned as casual ethnic/occasion wear than as a conventional western shirt.
buying_advice.price_advice: The captured listing shows ₹439 with an MRP of ₹1,699, while another variant is shown at ₹329. Treat price as variant-dependent rather than a single fixed price.

source_inconsistencies: The listing advertises a cotton-polyester blend, while a negative verified review disputes the softness and quality of the material.
Fit is listed as regular, but a verified 4XL review reports inaccurate sizing.
Some customers report color differences compared with the website images.
The source contains Yellow as a reviewed variant, but the supplied SHIRT-008 image directory does not contain a Yellow image.

shopi_ai_rules.primary_rule: Recommend this primarily as a budget casual short kurta with a Mandarin collar, especially for parties, weddings, festive outings and everyday ethnic-casual wear.
shopi_ai_rules.material_rule: State the material as Cotton Polyester Blend. Never describe it as pure cotton.
shopi_ai_rules.quality_rule: Do not call this premium or exceptionally durable because customer feedback is mixed.
shopi_ai_rules.fit_rule: Use Regular Fit as the catalog attribute, but tell users to check the size chart.
shopi_ai_rules.occasion_rule: Prioritize casual ethnic, party, wedding and festive recommendations over conventional western-shirt recommendations.
shopi_ai_rules.color_rule: Do not guarantee that the physical color will exactly match the product image.
shopi_ai_rules.stitching_rule: Do not promise premium or highly durable stitching.
shopi_ai_rules.price_rule: Treat ₹439 as the captured price for the selected listing snapshot, not as a universal price for all variants.
shopi_ai_rules.variant_rule: Only expose Black, Brown, Maroon, Navy Blue, Sky Blue and White in the storefront because those are the colors for which SHIRT-008 images were supplied.
shopi_ai_rules.comparison_rule: When comparing with SHIRT-007, prefer SHIRT-008 for ethnic, festive, wedding or Mandarin-collar styling. Prefer SHIRT-007 for western casual polo styling.
